articles.summary: Bird CEO Robert Vis responds to CM.com issuing 1,020,408 new shares at EUR 4.90 to one investor — diluting holders 3% below Bird’s EUR 5.16 all-cash offer.
articles.title: Bird responds to CM.com's dilutive share issuance

articles.summary: Bird announces divestment of 172,977 CM.com shares at EUR 5.192. Following the sale, Bird holds 1,671,255 shares, representing 5.04% ownership in CM.com.
articles.title: Daily Share Divestment of shares in CM.com

articles.summary: A Black Friday playbook for running email, SMS, and WhatsApp from one platform, with segmentation, a 72-hour schedule, and post-purchase follow-up.
articles.title: The Black Friday Playbook

articles.summary: Bird withdraws its proposed takeover of CM.com and will continue focusing on independent growth in the Netherlands. Read the full press release.
articles.title: Bird withdraws proposal for takeover of CM.com
